description: This file defines configuration-related data structures and functions for loading and parsing Gateway configuration data from a JSON file in a macOS application. It includes structures for holding configuration parameters, functions for reading and interpreting the configuration file, and handling of nested JSON data.

classes.name: GatewayConfig
classes.description: A structure holding configuration parameters for the gateway such as mode, bind address, port, remote URL, and authentication tokens.

classes.name: GatewayEndpoint
classes.description: A structure representing a gateway endpoint with URL, token, password, and mode.

methods.name: loadGatewayConfig
methods.description: Loads and parses the gateway configuration JSON file, returning a GatewayConfig instance populated with data from the file.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Converts various representations of numbers (Int, Double, String) into an optional Int value.
